```text
# #3907: CI: GitHub releases failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[releases run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43560136871) failed, so the GitHub releases were not written: a version shipped since has no release, and a release whose title, notes or pre-release flag moved kept the old ones (the failed step's log says why).

Night bot: this is yours (`priority:medium`: nothing waits on a release, but none is written until it is fixed). Read the failed job's log, find the cause and fix it in a pull request on `main`. A failure outside your reach (`.github/`, a secret such as BOT_GITHUB_TOKEN, GitHub's settings) is a person's: say exactly what they must do. The next run that publishes closes this and writes whatever the failed runs left out.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/releases.yml`._
```
